note: Joshua Tree NP campground on the park's north edge off Hwy 62, between Joshua Tree village and Twentynine Palms; sandy sites tucked among granite boulders, popular with climbers. Only hiking trails link it to the rest of the park, so seeing the park means driving back out to an entrance. Only about ten sites take a 23-ft rig; many are tent-only or under 23 ft, so check the site's length before booking. Water is at the ranger station about 2 mi north. Wood and charcoal fires are banned June 1-October 1. --Claude
